meta.source: NDIA Supplement P, 13 editions; see data/panel/VALIDATION.md

story.headline: The surplus is growing: spare places nearly doubled since Dec 2023
story.evidence: From Dec 2023 to Jun 2026, 9,503 places were added and 2,547 more people came to use SDA. 14,437 places (46%) now have no SDA-funded resident.
story.caveat: Places not in SDA use is an upper bound on vacancy: a place can be occupied by someone not funded for SDA.

story.headline: It is not a lease-up blip: most new places are not taken up
story.evidence: Each new place brings about 0.24 people into use (0.19–0.30 across specifications), almost all within three quarters. Regions that stopped building absorbed under 1% of their spare places in a year.
story.caveat: Region-level: a net change in each region's totals, not dwellings followed one by one.

headline.enrolled: High Physical Support is increasingly oversupplied; Fully Accessible is increasingly short
headline.substitution: HPS + FA is balanced but rising; Improved Liveability is short

evidence.enrolled: High Physical Support 1.81 → 2.58; Robust 1.69 → 1.93; Improved Liveability 0.66 → 0.68; Fully Accessible 0.61 → 0.53 places per participant with need, Dec 2024 to Jun 2026.
evidence.substitution: Robust 1.69 → 1.93; HPS + FA 1.17 → 1.44; Improved Liveability 0.66 → 0.68 places per participant with need, Dec 2024 to Jun 2026.

story.caveat: A fifth of need has no design category (20% in Jun 2026). The dashed line spreads it across categories in proportion; the solid line leaves it out.

story.headline: The pipeline overstates what is coming
story.evidence: About 34% of the pipeline turns into enrolled dwellings each year. The 36-month rule removed at least 1,723 dwellings in Mar 2026, 20%–31% of the pipeline.
story.caveat: Pipeline figures before and after Mar 2026 are not comparable.

story.headline: The shortage is turning into an overhang
story.evidence: 31 regions have more people waiting than spare places, down from 60 in Dec 2023. Meanwhile 6,497 spare places sit in regions that could already house everyone waiting locally, up from 1,192.
story.caveat: People waiting are counted where they live, not where they would accept a place.
